children: Kazakhstan's QazaqStroy, one of the country's largest construction and property development companies, placed $1.190 billion worth of three-year bonds on the Astana International Exchange (AIX), according to a statement published on the exchange's website.
The coupon rate was set at 9%.

The company plans to use the proceeds from the placement to invest in the construction of a potash mining and processing complex with an annual capacity of 12 million tonnes at the Satimola deposit in West Kazakhstan.
